cut_method: ASR onset anchors from the 11-10 SRT (D:/岁己直播自动总结/SRT/) cross-checked against official LRC; median offset per song. Out-point from a -68 dB / -180 dB digital-silence valley measured on the real PCM. Dead-air / whisper-quiet heads dropped by shifting abs_start, LRC, acts, live windows and duration together.
